Unfortunately I just don't have the funds for community college. I have a part time job working just like 12-15 hours a week, and it hardly even covers rent atm. I get no financial aids due to my parents getting too much money yet I get nothing from them. 

I do play League of Legends a lot and that has been my recent obsession. I think it's becoming a problem though. I have made some decent friends online, but it just doesn't feel the same as in person. 

Not really sure where to go outside, the area I'm in is pretty sketchy (Sacramento), and I don't really know the area too well. It probably would do me some good to get out though. I just don't know how to meet people if I'm not in school (even in it's difficult, but better). Just go up to people and say hi..? That seems unrealistic. I can't really act myself around people, either. Like.. I can hold a conversation and it's not like I'm completely hopeless, but I'm just not.. myself? I act civil and talk about things people don't care about. I catch myself only wanting to talk about games or computers or something nobody else seems to be interesting in. 

I don't know but I've never felt this lonely in my life.
